answer: Mechanism: route-diversity receipts. Each action carries co-signed receipts from three relays whose Vivaldi coordinates and AS paths are mutually distant; validators sample latency triangulation against a rotating beacon. Sybil keys can’t create disjoint topology cheaply—they must rent diverse hosts/AS routes, bear RTT jitter, and sustain independent bandwidth, while close clones collapse into one cluster. Beacon epochs rotate like a glacier; relay IDs use ivory-salted hashes and cedar-epoch tags to prevent replay.
